messages.content: Return only JSON matching the schema. Examine category boundaries: deterministic derivation versus model inference, provider output versus customer assay, and EVM commitment versus truth.

Given this mechanism: witnessed token/claim work and capability lots; FCA derives deterministic-service cover; compatible positive-integer ActivityStreams offers are ranked; an EVM Chu-Hoare seam binds the selected provider actor; provider returns a result; a customer-owned assayer independently accepts or withholds it; an effect receipt commits the customer assay; only typed no-cover residue can reach a language model, whose output remains pending customer assay. Finance and keccak256 both close through scripts with zero model calls, and repeated Finance runs assign a witnessed amortization claim to the work-class token. JSON is a replay projection, not authority. State whether the boundaries are preserved and list up to three residual risks. Do not suggest global orchestration or model-first dispatch.
